court_name: High Court of Judicature at Bombay, Civil Appellate Jurisdiction
petitioner: Giri Textiles, through Proprietor Chandrayya R. Pasnuri

directives.text: Register and formally acknowledge receipt of the High Court's order in Writ Petition No. 15779 of 2025.
Update the case record for Application (BIR) No. 1 of 2014 to reflect the High Court's dismissal of the writ petition and affirmation of the Labour Court and Industrial Court orders.
Schedule and initiate further proceedings for the substantive adjudication of Application (BIR) No. 1 of 2014 before the Labour Court, Thane.

Adjudicate Application (BIR) No. 1 of 2014 strictly on its own merits, without being influenced by any prior observations, save and except for the High Court's conclusive ruling on the maintainability issue under Section 42(4) of the Maharashtra Industrial Relations Act, 1946 read with Rule 53 of the Rules.
Monitor and expedite the disposal of Application (BIR) No. 1 of 2014, with an endeavor to complete the process preferably within six months from the date of receipt of the High Court's order.
directives.deadline_text: within six months from the date of receipt of this order

directives.text: Ensure no costs are awarded or imposed on any party in relation to the proceedings.

raw_summary: The High Court dismissed the writ petition filed by Giri Textiles, thereby upholding the orders of the Labour Court and Industrial Court. The High Court affirmed that the objection raised by the petitioner regarding the non-maintainability of Application (BIR) No. 1 of 2014 due to alleged non-compliance with Section 42(4) of the Maharashtra Industrial Relations Act, 1946 read with Rule 53, is not valid. The Labour Court, Thane is directed to proceed with Application (BIR) No. 1 of 2014 on its own merits and endeavor to dispose of it expeditiously, preferably within a period of six months from the date of receipt of this order. No costs were awarded.
